5/S0.subgoal: Define augmented reality and identify the four characteristics used to recognize an AR system.

5/S1.subgoal: Distinguish AR and VR systems by explaining that AR alters real-world perception while VR replaces it.

5/S2.subgoal: Describe the main definitions of mixed reality and explain why the course treats MR as equivalent to AR.

5/S3.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.

goal.goal: Explain the foundational definitions of augmented reality, virtual reality, and mixed reality, including the identifying characteristics of augmented reality, the difference between augmented and virtual reality, the reality-virtuality continuum, and the course's treatment of mixed reality as augmented reality.
goal.achieves: Provides the learner with the basic XR terminology needed to follow later explanations of XR systems and to build toward understanding and implementing an XR system.

objectives.goal: Explain the foundational definitions of augmented reality, virtual reality, and mixed reality, including the identifying characteristics of augmented reality, the difference between augmented and virtual reality, the reality-virtuality continuum, and the course's treatment of mixed reality as augmented reality.
objectives.achieves: Gives the learner a common vocabulary and conceptual framework for AR, VR, and MR to use when studying later course topics on XR hardware, human factors, system development, and optimization.
